_doc: The /a rooms the phone walk visits (scripts/admin-walk.cjs). Hand-declared, like console-matrix.routes.json: a new operator room is a deliberate edit here.
The fifteen rooms in the operator's own menu, plus the two back rooms that render (Brand, Test join). /a/live lands on Studio and the eleven house rooms land on Home, so they are not walked twice.
name = the heading the room must say (A5). private: true = the room shows member data (People shows member email addresses). The walk measures it but never takes its picture.
